question: The anatomical dead space:

options.opa: It is always greater than the physiological one.
options.ope: Includes the volume of inspiratory reserve.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Anatomical dead space -> does not participate in gas exchange -> 80% CHAIN: Anatomical dead space -> includes the volume of the conducting airways -> does not contribute to gas exchange -> 85% CHAIN: Anatomical dead space -> consists of the volume of the respiratory tract where no gas exchange occurs -> 80%
